name: const unsafe fn read_unaligned < T > (src : * const T) -> T
rule: A pointer obtained by casting a reference is guaranteed valid for use as `src` while the underlying object remains live and no reference, rather than just raw pointers, is used to access the same memory; reference and raw-pointer accesses must not be interleaved during that period.
api: const unsafe fn read_unaligned < T > (src : * const T) -> T
